caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, closed color shapes, pattern equal to form, ornamental border, a standing bodhisattva on a lotus throne with a jewelled crown and scarves, striped skirt and bands of flower rosettes down the banner, small donor figures and cloud scrolls on a warm ground, cinnabar red, malachite green, azurite blue, ochre, jade white
